# @sencha/extjs/no-ext-create

Report the usage of Ext.create()


## Rule Details

This rule will report when Ext.create() is used.  

In this example, we use `Ext.create('Ext.panel.Panel')` instead of `new Ext.panel.Panel`. Each has their own pros and cons but if you want to report
when `Ext.create` is used instead of the `new` keyword, add this rule to your ESLint config.

_ESLint Config_

```js
{
    "plugins": [
        "@sencha/extjs"
    ],
    "extends": [
        // this rule is NOT in the recommended configuration list
        // so including this line will NOT enables this rule
        "plugin:@sencha/extjs/recommended"
    ],
    "settings": {
        "extjs": {
            "toolkit": "classic",
            "fromVersion": 4,
            "toVersion": 7.9
        }
    },
    "rules": {
        // to use this rule you must manually enter it
        // here, in the "rules" section
        "@sencha/extjs/no-ext-create": "warn"
    }
}
```

_JavaScript_

```js
var panel = Ext.create('Ext.panel.Panel', { 
    width: 200,
    height: 200,
    html: 'Hello World'
});
```

_Problem Message reported by ESLint_

```
Use new Ext.panel.Panel() rather than Ext.create('Ext.panel.Panel')
```
